summary.text: Valli Geiger is a Democratic member of the Maine House of Representatives from District 42 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A nurse and health policy analyst by background, she lives in Rockland, Maine.

paragraphs.text: Valli Geiger was born on the Chanute Air Force Base in Illinois and lives in Rockland, Maine.
She earned a bachelor's degree in nursing from Niagara University in 1977 and a master's degree in sustainable design from Boston Architectural College.
Her career experience includes working as clinical director of Federally Qualified Health Centers, director of Health Reach's hospice program, a nurse, and a health policy analyst.
Ballotpedia lists Geiger's tenure in the Maine House as beginning in 2020, with the current District 42 seat assumed on December 6, 2022.

In 2023-2024 she was assigned to the Energy, Utilities and Technology Committee and the Labor and Housing Committee, and in 2021-2022 to the Innovation, Development, Economic Advancement and Business Committee.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
